en.topic_title: Taiwan probes 17 China-funded firms over high-tech talent poaching
en.topic_summary:
Taiwanese investigators said Wednesday they have raided dozens of locations as part of a probe into 17 Chinese-funded companies suspected of trying to “illegally” poach Taiwan’s high-tech talent to erode the island’s competitive edge.



Taiwan’s Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau. Photo: Wikicommons via CC2.0.
